easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Forest or Island.
description:
Activate a basic Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G} or {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping that land.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.
